intuition: A new price absorbs every earlier price no greater than itself when determining its span.

brute_force.approach: Store all prices and scan backward until a strictly greater price is found for each request.

optimal.approach: Maintain a decreasing stack of price and accumulated-span pairs, popping dominated entries.

edge_cases: Equal earlier prices are included in the current span.
A new all-time high absorbs every prior stack entry.
